reviews.x: Some reviewers have complained that the bristles are too soft, but these brushes are perfect.  My prosthodontist, who teaches other dentists about implants and removable appliances, said that brushes need to be strong enough to clean, but gentle enough not to cause damage.  These brushes fit that description perfectly while still being affordable.  I'm really happy I found these!

reviews.t: These are not too soft, they're just-right soft
reviews.x: You could clean your teeth, if you choose to, with a steel wire brush. But if you want to clean without scratching, the medium-soft bristles on these brushes are perfect. In fact, the brush itself is almost identical in every way to the G.U.M. brush given to me by a previous dentist. Since several reviewers here have objected to the softness, I did a little online research, uncovering this:  'Apply a little bit(of denture paste or cream) on a soft brush and rinse your dentures well with warm (no

reviews.t: Not like the brush I got years ago
reviews.x: Bristles too soft and small end not big enough to reach into the area of the upper denture that needs cleaning. I really need to replace my old brush (many years old) but these do not seem to be available in stores so I gave this a try. Not what I need so I will keep looking.

The quality seems excellent. I like the cover. What I liked best was the label on the package that says it is from China and is a "false toothbrush."  What I don't like is the handle. It is comfortable when cleaning with the narrow brush. However, when cleaning with the large, flat brush, the curved handle, which comes to a point, digs into my hand. I guess I'm the only one who feels that way, though, given that the other reviews don't mention this issue.

Great product. Each brush has its own travel cap, so they are an excellent value. My first choice when it’s time for replacements. Plus, it’s reassuring to know the vendors care about quality customer service.
Nice brushed for a fair price. Arrived quickly.
Love the protected cover it has with it.

I was very pleased when the denture toothbrush showed up. It is  very well made and easy for a senior citizen to hold. The brush cleans my dentures quickly and easily when I eat something like blueberries or blackberries. My only complaint was The cover I had a little problem getting it open and maybe I’m slow but I even had a little problem figuring out how to open it. But this denture brush is totally worth the money.

These are nice brushes. The size is perfect and they fit in your hand perfectly. I love the covers and they could be used on any denture brush. My biggest complaint is that the brushes are too soft. I just recently got dentures and my dentist recommends a very stiff denture brush. These brushes are probably softer than a soft toothbrush.

I'm new to these type of brushes so my review is from a beginner. It's well made and fits the hand reallly good. If it's to soft or to stiff? To me it's good, not too soft, not too stiff. If you want a better answer to that you may have to ask your dentist. It does what I need it to. A 3 pack of brushes for that price was a good deal.

reviews.t: Bristles not as stiff as preferred
reviews.x: While adequate when judged on its own merits, the bristles on the Koala come nowhere close to the ones found on the original Sea-Bond denture brushes. As I still have a supply of both, I rate the bristles on the Sea-Bond to be 'hard' with the bristles of the Koala to be 'medium-soft'

reviews.t: They do the job for sure
reviews.x: First time I’ve tried these and they work fine. I have some arthritis in my hands and I like a stiffer brush and these have both softer and fairly stiff in the center of the head.

I like the item very much. Having each brush come with its own plastic cover is just what I was looking for. And they're a real bargain for the price. Seeing as the includes not only three brushes, but each brush has it's own cover. It makes them perfect for traveling or just to keep them sanitary on your bathroom sink counter. I would definitely recommend these to other shoppers.

reviews.t: I really like the brush with covers
reviews.x: I really like the brush with covers. I have looked for years for covers and this is the first time I have found them and on such nice brushes.  The handles are just the right size to hold.  I wish the brush was a little firmer but it did a wonderful job.  I will buy them again.
This is the BEST denture brush I have ever had. You can't find them in the stores for some reason which is fine with me because these are 1,000 times better than any out of the store any ways.
I have used one once but I like the feel and hold of it (as that has been an issue for me). I also really like the little cases to keep them clean. not too hard, but just right to clean well.

reviews.t: Yours are perfect and I like the additional covers
reviews.x: I have looked high and low for a denture brush locally and was unable to find any. Yours are perfect and I like the additional covers. A very  nice product.
For it’s purpose it was very effective. I just wished that the bristles are a little bit more harder. But overall, I’m very happy with this product.
great people to work with. highly recommend trying their products.

reviews.t: ... but not as stiff as my sister and I like.
reviews.x: They're alright but not as stiff as my sister and I like.
This product is of high quality and arrived speedily.

Very happy with these brushes!  They are well made, easy to hold and the head fits inside the denture perfectly for great cleaning!  They each have their own little snap on storage case which makes them great for travel. The case is easy to open, just squeeze top and bottom together and it pops right open.  I would highly recommend these brushes and the price is great!

I really like this product. The bristles are firm. The handle just right. The cover is an extreme plus! You get 3 brushes & NOT only 1 cover for the whole batch BUT an individual cover for each of the brushes. So u get 3 brushes AND 3 covers. I recommend these brushes with cover whether u traveling or just stay at home. It's perfect for either situation.

The brushes are the right shape and angle that feels comfortable to me.  Some others just feel awkward.  For my personal preference, I wish the bristles were a bit stiffer, but they are a bit stiffer than many others I've purchased.  The plastic bristle cover is a nice feature for traveling.

I use denture brushes to clean crazing in antique porcelain dishes. Koala’s denture brushes have medium hard bristles, more like hard toothbrush bristles than the wiry ones usually found in denture brushes. This is also better for denture cleaning as it won’t cause scratches.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the bristles too soft or softer than they prefer, though some consider them just right.
Reviewers frequently praise the included individual covers, valuing them for travel and hygiene.
Customers describe the brushes as well made and comfortable or easy to hold.
Several reviewers consider the brushes a good value or bargain, especially given the three-pack with covers.
A few reviewers mention the handle being uncomfortable or the cover being hard to open.
